episodes.title: Ange
episodes.summary: As Isabelle arrives in Pleasant Court, local realtor and perfectionist, Ange soon suspects the mysterious visitor is not who she says she is.

episodes.title: Essie
episodes.summary: Struggling with motherhood, Essie finds a new friend in Isabelle, blissfully unaware that Isabelle has a hidden agenda.

episodes.title: Lulu
episodes.summary: Tension around Lulu and Holly's parenting choices comes to the surface just as Isabelle's investigation zones in on Lulu and her daughter, Elvis.

episodes.title: Fran
episodes.summary: Struggling with her husband's depression, Fran is put in a compromised position when Isabelle leverages her guilt to access confidential files.

episodes.title: Isabelle
episodes.summary: As tensions in the court rise, the truth of Isabelle's investigation is finally revealed.

episodes.title: Barbara
episodes.summary: Isabelle unravels the truth, but is faced with a dilemma, is she prepared to destroy one family, to heal another?
